title: The Biggest Number on the Box

slices.alt: Comic, part 1 of 13: Verdict Picks Toon: The Biggest Number on the Box
Comic, part 2 of 13: Caption: Black Friday week. Every robot vacuum ad shouts one number. Sam: This one says 30,000 Pa. Biggest number wins, right?
Comic, part 3 of 13: Caption: Pa is suction pressure, measured in a sealed lab setup. It is the biggest number in every ad.
Comic, part 4 of 13: (Sound: BEEP BEEP) Caption: Three days later, in his imagination.
Comic, part 5 of 13: Vera: Owners don't send robots back for weak suction. Vera: They send them back because they get stuck.

Comic, part 6 of 13: Board, Vacuum Wars 24-object obstacle course, 2026: Roborock Saros 10R 24 of 24; eufy Omni S2 24 of 24; Several mid-range camera robots in the teens Source: Vacuum Wars obstacle tests, as summarized in our guide.
Comic, part 7 of 13: Sam: So I skip the suction number? Vera: Read the pickup tests. The Pa on the box has inflated 15-fold in five years.
Comic, part 8 of 13: Caption: 11:30 p.m. Sam: 33% off! That has to be the deal.

Comic, part 9 of 13: Board, A robot vacuum "deal," in dollars: List price $1,999; What it really sold for about $1,400; The "33% off" deal $1,349; What you actually save about $50 Source: RobovacGuide's Black Friday playbook, July 11, 2026 (its worked example).
Comic, part 10 of 13: Sam: FIFTY DOLLARS?!

Comic, part 11 of 13: Vera: And the box price isn't the whole price. Vera: Bags, filters, brushes, mop solution: they add up. Board, Consumables over three years: Self-empty robot $100–$200; Omni robot (washes its mop) $250–$400 Source: our estimate from 2026 maker accessory prices; daily runs, about 1,500 sq ft.
Comic, part 12 of 13: Caption: Next morning. Step one: measure under the sofa. Sam: 3.5 inches. Turret robots start at about 3.8 (maker specs).

Comic, part 13 of 13: Caption: The tip: measure your clearance, buy the robot that gets stuck least, and judge a deal in dollars. Sam: Fits under the sofa, doesn't get stuck. Deal. Which robot fits your floors? Fourteen picks, compared below.
